Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord empowers people to create spaces where they can find a sense of belonging in their lives. Millions of people trust Discord to keep their communications secure, private, and out of the hands of evildoers, so security and privacy are necessary to Discord's success.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Application Security team and protect Discord’s users where it matters most, their accounts. If you are an engineer with a wealth of experience making the secure way the easy way, a deep sense of curiosity, and an endless desire to improve Discord, read on!

Lead full-stack work to strengthen session security and authentication for Discord’s users.
Improve, operate, and maintain security-critical authentication services, owning their correctness and security.
Partner with Product teams to drive adoption of stronger authentication and to ship user-facing account security tools.
Identify and design solutions for emerging threats to user account security.
Research and implement new security capabilities for the Discord platform, staying current on the authentication and session security landscape.
Build security controls and tools that emphasize self-service, automation, and performance to help identify and mitigate account security flaws.

You have 5+ years of experience securing production applications.
You have 3+ years of experience programming in at least one general-purpose programming language (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or Rust).
You have hands-on experience building and shipping production software, including security features, controls, frameworks, or guardrails.
You have hands-on experience with authentication and account security, such as WebAuthn, passkeys, FIDO2, MFA, and session management.
You are comfortable reasoning about the security of complex systems, even if they contain components you aren’t familiar with, and can give engineers clear, sound guidance on secure design and implementation.
You have experience leading security projects with a cross-functional group.
You have experience building or hardening client applications, such as desktop or native mobile apps.
You have experience operating in cloud-based environments (we use Google Cloud, but experience with other platforms is okay too).

Experience programming in at least one systems programming language (e.g. C, C++).
Experience developing, operating, and debugging production systems.
Familiarity with common application vulnerabilities on the platforms Discord ships on (that's all of them).
Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.

Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.

Software Engineer - Synthetic Monitoring The Opportunity: The Synthetic Monitoring squad builds and operates Grafana Cloud Synthetic Monitoring, used by teams globally to proactively verify that their critical user journeys, APIs, and services work as expected - before their customers notice they don't.

Synthetic Monitoring is a multi-tenant distributed system implemented in Go, running on Kubernetes across all major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), executing billions of synthetic tests each month from probe locations around the world and from customer-operated private probes.

The product is in a scale phase, and our focus is on making Synthetic Monitoring a deeply integrated part of Grafana Cloud: connecting checks to real user experience and cross-product investigation workflows, making check results a trusted signal for AI-assisted workflows, and enabling large organizations to operate the product at enterprise scale on our infrastructure and on their own private probes.

The role is full-stack in the real sense: the same engineer who designs how a check execution flows through scheduling, probes, and the telemetry pipeline should also be able to build the workflow that lets a user understand and act on the result.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software.

We are looking for Software Engineers who are passionate about building reliable systems and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks.

What you'll be doing: As a Software Engineer on the Synthetic Monitoring squad, you will work across the whole system - Go services and agents on the backend, a TypeScript/React application on the frontend and you'll be expected to reason about it as one system, not two halves. Specifically, you will:

Own features end-to-end across the stack : from API and data model design in Go, through the execution pipeline, to the user-facing workflows in TypeScript/React

Design and evolve systems, not just features : contribute to architectural decisions on scheduling, probe lifecycle, telemetry ingestion, and API design that shape how the product scales

Build the cross-product and AI-assisted workflows that connect Synthetic Monitoring to the wider Grafana Cloud platform

Make the product operable at enterprise scale : the governance and organization primitives that let teams with hundreds of checks manage Synthetic Monitoring as code and with confidence

Break down complex, ambiguous problems into incremental deliverables and iterate quickly based on feedback

Ensure quality through testing, observability of your own systems, and documentation : our checks are something customers alert on, so reliability is a feature

Be a part of the team's on-call rotation and take ownership of the services you're running
We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction.

We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. Technologies you'll work with:
Go (backend services, APIs, and the synthetic monitoring agent)
TypeScript / React (the Synthetic Monitoring app in Grafana)
Kubernetes across AWS, GCP, and Azure
k6 (the execution engine behind scripted and browser checks)
Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Prometheus)

Strong Go, or a path to it. We build Synthetic Monitoring in Go. Deep experience building and operating production backend systems in another systems language (Rust, Java, C++) translates well; backend experience limited to JavaScript/Node.js runtimes does not.

Operational mindset. You've run what you've built: you've owned production services, understand what it means to carry a pager, and treat reliability and toil reduction as part of the product.
You are a systems thinker : you reason about how components interact - data flow, failure modes, cost, and operational behavior - not just how a single feature works in isolation.

Pragmatism and short feedback loops. You break complex problems into increments: analyze, design, deliver an MVP, learn, iterate. You are able to design a solution, get feedback, and write a prototype by yourself - the ability to work on your own is crucial.
You have a good understanding of a software development process that takes a user-centered approach . You easily build an understanding of the users' context and goals which will help you build the right solution with the maximum value.
You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow - whether for accelerating exploration, code review, or reasoning through design tradeoffs - and you're thoughtful about where they help and where they don't.

Unsere Projekte entstehen unter anderem in Zusammenarbeit mit Hochschulen, Museen, Bildungseinrichtungen, Kommunen und Industrieunternehmen. Dabei verbinden wir neue Technologien mit konkreten Anwendungen in Bildung, Forschung, Kultur und Industrie.

Die Stelle

Core Equity — Owns the foundational logic that powers Ledgy ’s equity engine. Every equity-related event — such as issuing shares, creating new pools, or adjusting ownership — generates transactions. s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
You'll work with HelloFresh's GenAI Enablement Squad , a cross-functional team helping teams across the company unlock the practical value of AI. The mission is simple: identify high-impact problems, build AI-powered solutions that solve them, and scale what works.

As a Staff Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of engineering, product, and business.

One week you might be embedded with the HR or Finance teams understanding how they work; the next you'll be building an agentic workflow, integrating it into the internal tooling, or scaling a successful prototype into a production system used across the company.
This is a highly hands-on role. You'll work on problems from discovery to production, working directly with engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders. Rather than waiting for requirements, you'll help define them—identifying where AI can create real leverage and shipping solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
While you'll support and advise other engineers and influence technical direction, your primary impact comes from building products people actually use.

Partner directly with teams across HelloFresh to understand their workflows, uncover opportunities, and identify where AI can meaningfully improve productivity or decision-making.
Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions and validate them with real users before investing in production systems.
Design, build, and operate production-grade AI applications including agents, workflow automations, retrieval systems, developer tools, and business assistants.
Deliver projects end-to-end—from problem discovery and solution design through implementation, deployment, measurement, and iteration.
Build reusable AI assistants distributed through the internal plugin marketplace, helping teams solve recurring problems without reinventing the wheel.
Turn successful one-off solutions into reusable platform capabilities that accelerate future AI development across the organisation.
Work closely with platform engineers to improve the internal AI infrastructure, ensuring solutions remain reliable, secure, observable, and cost-effective.
Share knowledge across the engineering organisation and support teammates through design discussions, pairing, and technical guidance.

Experience building production AI applications using modern LLMs, including agents, RAG, workflow automation, structured generation, evaluation, and prompt engineering.
Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building reliable, maintainable, observable production systems.
A product mindset—you care as much about user adoption and business impact as technical elegance.
Experience working directly with customers or business stakeholders to understand ambiguous problems and translate them into software.
Comfort moving quickly from idea to prototype while knowing when to invest in scalability and production quality.
Experience working with managed AI platforms such as AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google Vertex AI.
Strong programming skills in Python or another modern backend language.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to both engineers and non-technical audiences.
Curiosity, pragmatism, and a willingness to experiment. You know there is rarely a perfect AI solution—only one that delivers meaningful value.

Experience building internal developer platforms or productivity tooling.
Experience evaluating LLM quality, latency, and cost trade-offs.
Experience deploying AI systems at organisational scale.
Familiarity with MCP, tool calling, agent orchestration frameworks, or workflow engines.
Experience measuring AI adoption and defining product success metrics.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

About Proton
Join Proton and build a better internet where privacy is the default
Proton was founded in 2014 by scientists from CERN on a simple truth: privacy is a fundamental human right . Since then, we’ve built the world’s largest encrypted email service (Proton Mail) and expanded into Proton VPN, Proton Drive, Proton Pass, and Proton Calendar—tools used by millions globally to protect their freedom, fight censorship, and keep their data safe. In some situations, Proton has literally helped save lives!
We are profitable, independent (no VC control), and selectively hire from the top ~1% of applicants. Our 500+ team members across 50+ countries come from leading organizations and elite academic backgrounds. We move fast, keep hierarchy light, and prioritize impact over optics. If you want to do meaningful work with exceptionally high-caliber people, this is it. Join us and do work you can truly be proud of. Check our open-source projects here !

Based in our Geneva (or Zürich) office, you'll join our browser product team, helping build a privacy-first internet browser used by millions around the world. From private-by-default browsing to shipping timely security updates, you'll work on a technically ambitious product with real-world impact.

As an engineer on the team, you'll collaborate closely with product, design, and more experienced engineers across Proton to build and ship a high-quality browsing experience on desktop, growing your craft while contributing to what "great" looks like for privacy-focused consumer products at scale.

You have hands-on experience building or maintaining a Chromium-based browser, or contributing to browser engineering at scale
You are proficient in C++ and comfortable navigating large codebases such as Chromium's (Blink, V8, network stack, sandboxing, extensions)
You have familiarity with Chromium's build system and cross-platform builds (macOS, Windows, Linux)
You have implemented privacy or security hardening in practice — anti-fingerprinting measures, content blocking, or reducing telemetry and third-party dependencies
You care deeply about product quality, performance, and delivering a fast, distraction-free user experience
You have solid knowledge of web platform standards and the security responsibilities of shipping a browser
You are comfortable navigating ambiguity in a small, high-ownership team, and experience working in open source is a strong plus
Rust experience is a plus as we explore platform-independent components

Work that Matters: millions of people trust Proton with their privacy. We answer only to our users — not advertisers, not investors with conflicting agendas, not governments. The work you do here is real, and the impact is measurable. (read more about our impact here )
Stock Options: at Proton, we all have the opportunity to be owners of the company. From day one, you have a real stake in what we're building. When Proton wins, you win.
Technology: you'll get the right hardware and the right software you need to do your best work.
Learning & Development: we invest in your growth because sharp people make us better. Proton is one of the fastest ways to accelerate your career because you'll be thrown into real challenges, with real ownership, from day one.
Employee Benefits: your wellbeing isn't an afterthought. We offer strong health coverage, solid retirement options, generous leave, and wellness support so you can bring your best self to work every day
In-Person Collaboration: Amazing things happen when passionate, smart, and purposeful people get together in the same room. With offices across Geneva, Zürich, Barcelona, London and more, you'll spend most of your time collaborating face-to-face with people who genuinely care about what they're building
Food: Lunch and snacks are on us every day in our offices so you can focus on the work and not on what's for lunch.
Transport: getting to the office shouldn't cost you. We cover public transport, bike allowances, or parking, whichever works for you.
Flexible Working: you own your schedule. Set hours that work for you and your team — because outcomes matter more than when the clock says you started.

Who we are
About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Tax compliance is a hard problem. When millions of payments flow through a marketplace or platform, the rules for what gets reported, to whom, in which format, and by when are complex, high-stakes, and vary by country.

The Connect Tax Reporting team builds products to help businesses collect and verify tax information, prepare and deliver tax forms, and manage reporting obligations across jurisdictions. This includes 1099 reporting in the US and digital platform reporting across the EU, Australia, Canada, the UK, and other regions.
This is a domain where correctness, reliability, and user trust matter deeply. A late filing, an incorrect form, or a missed reporting threshold can create regulatory risk and erode trust with platforms and their sellers. Our systems handle high-volume seasonal workflows, support complex country-specific rules, and remain dependable under fixed filing deadlines.

You’ll build products and systems that simplify tax reporting for platforms and their users. You’ll take projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operation.
Your work may include improving tax information collection, building APIs and data pipelines, automating reporting processes, and strengthening the reliability of production systems. You’ll collaborate with product managers, tax operations, support, and engineers across Stripe. AI-assisted development will be part of your day-to-day work as you design, build, test, and operate software.

Design, build, and operate features across tax reporting user experiences, APIs, services, and data workflows
Turn user and business needs into clear technical approaches and deliver projects from concept to launch
Build scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable software supported by appropriate tests
Improve tax reporting workflows through automation and operational tooling
Review code and collaborate with engineers to improve implementation quality and share technical context
Monitor production systems, respond to incidents, and improve reliability, observability, and runbooks
Partner with product, tax operations, support, and engineering teams to deliver solutions that meet user needs

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Experience debugging and operating production systems
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

Experience with distributed systems, asynchronous processing, large-scale data workflows, or search infrastructure
Experience with financial, compliance, reporting, or other systems where correctness, privacy, and data integrity matter
Interest in learning tax reporting concepts and building products for platforms and their users

About SugarAI UK Limited
SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.
We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.
More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.
Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.
If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality.
This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it.

It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships.

You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck.
If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.
This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

s.h: Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities)

Agentic Development Systems
Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves
Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review
Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality
Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly
Feature Delivery
Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments
Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates
Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers
Code Quality & Review
Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses
Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code
Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC

Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing
Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions
Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned
Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations

DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.
Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.
We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.
DRW has an opening for a Senior Software Engineer focused on digital assets. The team builds and operates systems that move and safeguard cryptoassets across the firm — including treasury automation, wallet inventory and reference data, integrations with custody platforms, and operational controls used by digital asset operations. You’ll work directly with those business partners and enjoy building meaningful products from day one.
At DRW we strive for an environment where technologists are free to pursue solutions to the problems of the business free from arbitrary management constraints and supported by excellent technical resources.

All development teams at DRW believe in rapid deployment and feedback, automated testing, and cohesive, transparent, lightly-coupled service architectures. We ship on Kubernetes with modern CI/CD. Candidates should have strong initiative and proven experience independently driving projects to completion.

We work from high-level requirements and value engineers who dig into the business to build the right thing.

· Designing, building, and testing full-stack applications (APIs through UI) used by digital asset operations and related business partners
· Partnering with those teams to turn ambiguous business problems into clear technical plans and shipped software
· Owning software end-to-end after it ships — we run what we build (deploy, operate, on-call); we don’t hand systems off to a separate ops team
· Working across greenfield systems and existing codebases
· Building and improving tooling and processes around CI/CD, containers, and Kubernetes / internal cloud
· Collaborating with other software teams, trading desks, and business units
· Mentoring and raising the bar for engineering practice on a small team
· Learning and championing useful new technologies where they fit

· We are looking for strong senior engineers with crypto or digital-asset systems experience. Deep Python expertise is a meaningful differentiator for this role.
· Cryptoassets, digital-asset operations, or custody / wallet platforms (or closely adjacent high-stakes money-movement systems)
· DeFi, smart contracts, staking, or other on-chain systems
· Full-stack development with Python (FastAPI)
· Strong relational data modeling fundamentals
· GitOps and Kubernetes
· Job orchestration systems (Airflow, Prefect, etc.)

Prima could be the place for you.
Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable and consistent services, writing reusable, modular, and maintainable code aligned with industry best practices.
Collaborate closely with stakeholders, product managers, and engineering managers to translate business requirements into effective software solutions, define timelines, and estimate effort.
Perform code reviews, enforce coding standards, troubleshoot and debug complex issues, and ensure high code quality and performance.
Stay up to date with new technologies and tools, drive their adoption when appropriate, and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and team growth.

Extensive experience in backend development, with solid knowledge of event-driven architectures, microservices, and domain-driven design.
Strong English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
Self-motivated, proactive, and accountable, with strong problem-solving skills and a growth mindset.
Experience working in an Agile environment.
Nice-to-Have
Good knowledge of functional programming languages.
Professional experience with Rust and/or Elixir.
First-hand experience of test-driven development (TDD), Event-Sourcing and CQRS.
Experience with messaging systems such as RabbitMQ or Kafka.

Doch der Markt verschiebt sich: KI-Inferenz wird teuer, Kunden öffnen sich für die Cloud, SaaS rückt in den Fokus. Um diesen Wandel – und alles, was noch kommt – aktiv mitzugestalten, bauen wir gerade das Core-Entwicklungsteam auf, das myScribe durch die nächsten Jahre trägt. Sei dabei.

GoldSim, a Datacor company, is a world leader in dynamic simulation software for water resources, environmental systems, and complex engineering problems.

Our customers use GoldSim to model some of the most challenging questions in engineering and science from managing critical water supplies to assessing the long-term safety of environmental systems. We are looking for a creative problem-solver to join our development team.

This is a mid-level to senior position where you will have a direct impact as we develop new modeling capabilities to enhance GoldSim, our state-of-the-art modeling and simulation framework.

What you’ll Do Numerical & Algorithmic Ownership Own the numerical solutions and mathematical/computer science algorithms underlying GoldSim's simulation engine - from the theoretical foundation (equations, algorithm design) through to implementation in our C++ codebase.

Push practical, real-world improvements to GoldSim's numerical capabilities, and propose new features driven by everyday or discipline-specific customer needs. Participate in design discussions across the full development lifecycle, not just the mathematical layer.

Model Building & Verification Build GoldSim models that apply and exercise the platform's numerical capabilities - for QA and verification, as example models shipped with the product, and in direct support of customers. Use hands-on model-building as a primary way to validate that new or improved algorithms behave correctly in practice.

Documentation & Knowledge Transfer Document both the theoretical basis (equations, algorithm descriptions) and the practical implementation of GoldSim's numerical methods, so this knowledge isn't concentrated in one person. Partner with the founding engineer to formalize existing modeling, QA, and support methodology.

Collaboration & Support Work alongside the software engineering team to integrate new or improved numerical capabilities into the broader platform. Translate business and product requirements into technical specifications. Serve as a technical resource for customer support and QA on advanced modeling and numerical questions.

Communicate technical/mathematical concepts clearly to engineers, QA, and product stakeholders. Growth & Modernization
Bring curiosity for modern computational approaches - including applying machine learning to accelerate, approximate, or extend traditional numerical simulation methods.
Help identify opportunities to modernize GoldSim's existing algorithmic infrastructure.
Requirements Masters or PhD level in science or engineering, with outstanding academic performance. Broad experience with applied math and numerical methods for solving science and engineering problems (e.g., matrix algebra, numerical methods for solving partial differential equations).

Earth sciences or civil engineering background, preferably including contaminant transport modeling. Extensive C++ programming experience, ideally in scientific or engineering applications; familiarity with commercial or open-source numerical libraries and frameworks is a plus.

Proven ability to design and implement practical numerical solutions to real-world problems. Good communications skills, must write effectively and enjoy interacting with other team members. Experience developing and supporting Windows desktop applications is a plus, as is hands-on experience with data science tools such as MATLAB, R, or Tableau.

Experience applying AI/ML techniques (e.g., machine learning models, LLM-based tools, or AI-assisted development) to scientific or engineering software is a plus. Why GoldSim Join a team where your work directly shapes software that engineers and scientists rely on around the world.

You'll take on meaningful technical challenges, enjoy real autonomy, and help define the future of a product with a global reputation for excellence. We have offices across the US where you have the opportunity to come in as you would like including one in Seattle.

At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology.

Come be a part of what’s next. We launched a new ad-supported tier in November 2022 and are building an in-house world-class ad tech ecosystem to offer our members more choices in consuming their content.

Our new tier allows us to attract new members at a lower price point while also creating a compelling path for advertisers to reach deeply engaged audiences. Our Team The Ads Engineering team at Netflix is dedicated to creating a world-class advertising ecosystem that drives our advertising business.

This team's mission is to develop advanced technology that ensures exceptional experiences for both our members and advertisers. Our responsibilities encompass a broad spectrum of products, ranging from sales and media planning to optimizing advertiser outcomes and execution.

This includes inventory and order management, campaign execution, ad serving, audience and identity management, measurement, reporting, and finance.

We use several Netflix investments and innovations - a unique mix of client and server-side ad insertions, state-of-the-art content delivery systems, ad encoding recipes, content understanding, and metadata, etc. We deliver ads in a manner that’s thoughtful of our member’s viewing experience and drive great outcomes for advertisers.

We also ensure that advertiser brand safety is ensured during serving so that members only see the most appropriate ads for them. Our team is faced with the enormous ambitions of building highly performant advertising systems and delivering high impact to our business by monetizing our incredible slate of content.

As one of the newest entrants in the Connected TV advertising space that’s rapidly growing, we seek to build unique value propositions that help us differentiate us and become a market leader in record time.

Our roles come with expectations of delivering in a rapid clip, comfort with lofty goals and big ambitions, the visibility that comes with strategic initiatives, and responsibility and an appetite to operate like a startup within an established company.

We are looking for engineers to join us on this journey, to be a part of some exciting initiatives, and the talented teams who work on realizing our ambitious vision. Skills & experience we’re seeking:
Well grounded domain experience in any of the following areas: Ad Serving, Ads Identity & Audiences, Ads Creatives, Inventory & Forecasting, Campaign Management, Media Planning, Measurement, Reporting, or Ads Finance.
General understanding of the advertising marketplace and landscape.
Worked closely with ad operations to enable campaign setup, targeting, reporting and advertiser needs.
Developed many cloud based applications and comfortable with modern programming languages (preferably object oriented),
Familiar with A/B testing and experimentation.
Have solid experience in setting technical directions for engineering projects, making architectural decisions, and influencing partner and cross-functional teams.

Contributed to an ads industry technology standard (e.g VAST, OpenRTB) or worked on an industry consortium effort, working group etc.
Familiarity with legal compliance and changing landscape of ads regulations around the world.
Experience working in the CTV space and knowledge of it’s unique constraints
Spotlight on Ads Engineering Teams: The Ad Supply team manages the policies and technical integrations for third-party ad supply. While Netflix has traditionally licensed content, we're exploring this alternative funding model.

The team solves complex challenges, such as determining how both Netflix and the third-party partner can sell ad inventory for the same content without conflict. They establish clear rules for inventory sharing, campaign setup, and system configurations to ensure consistency and fairness.

The Ads Measurement team builds systems that enable advertisers on Netflix to quantify campaign outcomes. Leveraging a blend of Netflix innovations and both first-party and third-party solutions, we deliver ads that respect the viewing experience while driving impactful results for advertisers.

Our tools empower advertisers to effectively measure and analyze these outcomes. The Ads Identity and Audience team is dedicated to delivering a relevant and engaging advertising experience while prioritizing consumer privacy.

Our mission is to maintain precise subscriber identities to ensure that ads are not only engaging but also respectful of consumer privacy choices and regional regulations.

We maintain a high-quality Identity Graph, which is used for various purposes, including respecting privacy choices and regulations, audience onboarding, targeting, measurement, and reporting.

The Ads Creatives & Policy team at Netflix is at the forefront of developing innovative solutions that enhance the ad experience for both viewers and advertisers. We are responsible for managing the lifecycle of ad creatives, ensuring compliance with policies, and leveraging cutting-edge technology to optimize ad delivery.

Joining our team means being part of a dynamic environment where your contributions directly impact the viewing experience of millions worldwide. The Ads Media Planning team is at the heart of designing and delivering state-of-the-art media planning solutions that power Netflix ’s advertising business.

We are developing innovative, in-house ad tech systems that enable advertisers and internal partners to efficiently plan, allocate, and optimize media investments across Netflix ’s platform.

Our technology translates advertiser objectives into actionable media plans, ensuring seamless integration, automation, optimization, compliance, and management of media strategies at scale.

We work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust media planning capabilities that serve our advertisers, members, and Netflix ’s broader business goals. The Live Ads Management team is driving one of Netflix ’s most exciting frontiers — bringing advertising to Live Events.

We’re building the intelligence that powers ad experiences during some of Netflix ’s biggest real-time moments, from live sports to global specials. Our team develops smart, scalable capabilities that help ad operations plan, set up, and deliver ads seamlessly during live broadcasts.

We’re pushing the boundaries with automated manifest generation, machine learning–driven optimizations, and agentic workflows that adapt in real-time to maximize both monetization and viewer experience.

We work hand in hand with creative, streaming, and ads engineering teams to make advertising on Netflix Live feel effortless — blending storytelling, technology, and real-time decisioning into one unforgettable experience. It’s a fast-moving, high-visibility team shaping how live entertainment and advertising come together on a global stage.

The Ads Platform Foundations team builds the core platforms, frameworks, and shared services that accelerate development across the Ads organization. We focus on enabling teams to move faster and build consistently through scalable UI infrastructure, common components, and foundational workflows.

Our work also powers access control across domains and underpins core systems such as Public API, GenAI foundations, and the Ads Entity Service — a knowledge graph connecting all Ads entities. Together, we provide the technical backbone that drives consistency, reliability, and velocity across Ads.

The Ads Campaign Management team is responsible for our in-house Order Management System (OMS) used by our account managers to facilitate the booking and execution of advertising campaigns on behalf of Agencies, Brands, and Advertisers.

The team owns key parts of our campaign hierarchy (Orders, Line Items) and closely intersects with almost every other team across Ads Engineering (Creatives, Forecasting, Audiences, Measurement, Ad Serving, etc) as well as business teams across Account Management and Ad Operations to facilitate the set-up, execution, and monitoring of ads across the Netflix ecosystem.

The Ads Inventory Management & Forecasting team builds state-of-art real-time inventory forecasting solutions leveraging ML models and high-performance ad server simulations.

The team also builds systems that enable publisher inventory management solutions, which support various monetization strategies such as dynamic pricing, rate card management, product packaging, inventory split, and yield optimization. The Ads Data Clean Room team is redefining how clean rooms are used in digital advertising.

We’re building data collaboration tools as internal services, allowing multiple teams to share data with external partners in a convenient and privacy-safe way. Our scope extends beyond traditional clean room use cases to include novel integrations where data has traditionally been shared more openly.

As the ads data landscape evolves, our team will continue to lead by creating new ways to enable collaboration while protecting privacy.

The Ads Finance team ’s vision is to establish a compliant, accurate, automated, and omni-channel Finance and billing system that streamlines and optimizes financial operations for ads, with a core charter to create a unified and compliant Revenue Recognition layer, Automate billing, Invoicing and Journal processes.

The Ads Finance platform centralizes and validates all the raw data—from campaign performance to pricing structures—needed to calculate and bill our diverse advertising revenue streams.

This ensures financial integrity and consistency, providing a reliable foundation for all core Ad business operations, including budgeting, predicting future revenue, and managing credit and pricing strategies.

The Ads Eventing team builds and operates the foundational systems that collect, validate, enrich, and deliver ads-related events at a massive scale. These high-throughput data pipelines ingest raw signals from client devices (TV, mobile), server-side ad insertions, and external third-party integrations.

The core mission is to transform these raw signals into clean, reliable, and privacy-safe data streams, ensuring data quality and fidelity across the board.

This critical infrastructure directly powers all core downstream functions, including real-time ad serving decisions, robust measurement and attribution systems, and financial reconciliation and billing workflows. The Ads Reporting Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering the final, actionable data to stakeholders.

Their focus is on building the systems that consume validated and enriched ads delivery data to power the comprehensive reporting surfaces used by internal teams and advertisers to analyze campaign performance and business outcomes.

They ensure the data presented is accurate, timely, and easy to consume, enabling key functions like measurement and attribution analysis, financial reconciliation, and strategic decision-making based on business results. The Ads CRM team delivers the AI-powered Go-to-Market platform, the strategic engine for Netflix Ads sales and marketing.

We don't just collect customer data; we create a unified, enriched view of our customers and their ad spend across every source, managing the entire lifecycle for impeccable quality and completeness.

Our intuitive UI and intelligent automation agents surface critical, actionable insights, empowering our sales teams to cut through the noise, focus on high-value client engagements, and accelerate the success of Netflix Ads. The Human Agent Tooling team builds the software Chime's support agents use every day to help members. When a member has a problem a bot can't solve, a human agent picks it up — and the tools we build are what let that agent understand the member's situation, take the right action, and resolve the issue quickly and safely. That includes the agent workspace, case management, the systems that surface member context in real time, and the controls that govern what actions agents can take.
Our mission is to make every human support interaction faster, safer, and more effective. When our tools work well, agents resolve issues in fewer clicks and members get better answers — and we measure our success by both.
We're investing heavily in this platform: modernizing the agent experience, building safer and more granular access controls, and improving how agent tooling connects to the rest of Chime's systems. We work closely with Product, Operations, and the agents themselves to shape what great support tooling looks like.
The base salary offered for this role and level of experience will begin at $117,000.00 and up to $162,000.00. Full-time employees are also eligible for a bonus, competitive equity package, and benefits. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.
In this role, you can expect to
Agent workspace — Contribute to the tools agents use to view member context, manage cases, and take action. You'll build well-scoped features that make agents' day-to-day faster and less error-prone.
Member context and case data — Help build the systems that pull together the right information about a member and surface it to the agent at the right moment.
Access controls and safety — Work on the permissions and guardrails that determine what actions agents can take on member accounts. These systems handle sensitive moments and need to be correct and reliable.
Integrations — Build and maintain the connections between agent tooling and the other Chime systems agents depend on, with support from your team.
Observability — Add logging, monitoring, and dashboards so we can see how tools are performing and catch issues early.
To thrive in this role, you have
Some professional software development experience (roughly 1+ years) or equivalent through internships, projects, or a strong CS foundation
Exposure to Ruby on Rails or a comparable web framework, or eagerness to learn it
Familiarity with working against a database
An appreciation for maintainable, well-tested code
A strong desire to learn and to dig into how things actually work
Curiosity about the people who use what you build

Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.

POS-12938 Senior Software Engineer I, Financial Systems The Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems role sits at the intersection of software engineering and financial systems.

This is a full-time software engineering role with a financial systems specialization -- a technologist who builds and owns the integration layer that keeps HubSpot financially accurate, compliant, and fast.

This role exists to partner with HubSpot 's Finance organization to make sure HubSpot can quickly and accurately understand its financial position, report revenue correctly, serve customers efficiently, and inform business decisions with reliable financial data.

It is a cross-functional role by design, built to work across Finance, Compliance, Security, Internal Audit, and external auditors alongside engineering and product teams. Engineers in this role own the integration layer across HubSpot 's financial systems: Aptitude, NetSuite, SOVOS, Avalara, and similar platforms.

The ongoing work is integration ownership, compliance, and incremental improvements to our reporting pipelines, revenue recognition systems, and general ledgers. The right candidate is a strong software engineer who finds financial systems compelling -- someone drawn to building at the intersection of technical rigor and financial correctness.

KEY EXPECTATIONS A Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems is a technologist. They can run with complex financial systems projects autonomously, design sound integrations, and deliver solutions that are both technically correct and financially rigorous.
Can iron out the vagaries of requirements, break problems down into tractable pieces, and implement each piece with minimal hand-holding.
Takes initiative and demonstrates ownership by driving quality improvements, resolving incidents, and following through on commitments to deliver reliable results.
Builds with financial rigor. Understands that a bug in a billing feature is a bad customer experience, but a bug in revenue recognition is a restatement. Financial correctness is a quality bar, not an afterthought.
Understands complex financial domains at a working level: revenue recognition principles (ASC 606 / IFRS 15), SOX compliance requirements (change management, segregation of duties, audit evidence, second reviewer), and how data moves across ERP, billing, and GTM systems.
Has hands-on experience with financial systems -- ERPs, financial software vendors, or billing and GTM integrations. Familiarity with systems like NetSuite, Aptitude, SOVOS, and Avalara is a strong signal.
Partners across engineering, product, compliance, finance, internal audit, external auditors, and security to build clear, reliable integrations with HubSpot 's financial systems. Can explain a system design to an auditor and a data flow to a controller.
Provides regular and proactive updates so all stakeholders -- engineering and non-engineering -- know where work stands.
Mentors or teaches other engineers on the team or in related areas.
Embraces and effectively leverages AI development tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) to enhance productivity and code quality.
When needed, actively participate in the interview process to hire the best people. Embodies HubSpot 's HEART and DI&B values throughout.
RELIABILITY EXPECTATIONS Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems build and maintain systems where an outage or data error has direct financial and legal consequences. Reliability means more than uptime -- it means financial reports are accurate, integrations run correctly, and any failure is documented and corrected completely.
They are a member of the team's PagerDuty rotation. Proficient in operations and incident response, and responsible and responsive to alerts. Can handle minor incidents autonomously but knows when to involve others.
Consistently produces well-tested software that handles failures gracefully and meets code quality guidelines.
Knows all rollout methods (gates, config, canary deploys, library canaries, pre-release tags) and when to use them.
Knows how to debug systems and applications effectively using tools like Metrics, Logfetch, Error Reporting, and Tracing.
Code reviews go deeper than surface-level. Gravitates toward discussions about unhandled edge cases, failure scenarios, performance issues, or regressions -- with particular attention to financial data correctness and edge cases in integration logic.
Raises issues if the team tries to move too fast, cut corners, or reliability starts to drop.
Takes ownership of reliability and security work. Completes work items independently and proactively. Triages work so there is enough time to complete it in SLA.
Owns the reliability of financial reporting and integrations. During month-end and quarter-end close, they are available and responsive. Integration failures that affect financial data are treated as high severity and resolved with urgency.
Incidents in financial systems are documented completely: root cause, impact on financial data, and remediation steps. Finance and Internal Audit are looped in appropriately.
Changes to SOX-controlled systems go through proper change management. Can serve as a qualified second reviewer on any controlled integration check they own.
GROWING IN THIS ROLE There is significant room for growth within the Senior Software Engineer, Financial Systems role. Engineers can grow in multiple directions:
Master existing technical skills and expand ownership across more of HubSpot 's financial systems stack.
Go deeper on compliance engineering: SOX controls, audit trail design, change management.
Take on broader system design work and own larger pieces of HubSpot 's financial data layer.
Develop a reputation as a trusted technical resource for Finance leadership and Internal Audit.
Mentor newer members of the Financial Systems team.
Serve as the technical leader for larger financial systems projects, working alongside Finance and engineering leadership to shape multi-year systems strategy.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build software that makes network operations safe, scalable, and boring — even as we launch new data centers and expand fast. This is not a “write scripts for configs” role: you’ll build the tooling and services that sit between the network core (switches/ports/VLANs, traffic processors) and the cloud platform on top, using open source where it fits and building the missing pieces where it doesn’t.

Build and maintain services and tooling that automate the network lifecycle: day-0 provisioning, day-N changes, drift detection, and operational verification
Make network changes safe and transparent: CI/CD workflows, diff/review tooling, staged rollouts/rollbacks, audit trails, and guardrails
Develop observability systems that scale across many sites: telemetry pipelines, signal quality, and tooling that shortens incident investigations
Close “last mile” gaps between the network and the platform: integrate source-of-truth data, expose APIs, and build reliable automation around it
Collaborate closely with network engineers and SREs to turn real operational pain into product-quality tooling

5+ years of professional software engineering experience (or equivalent practical background)
Strong coding skills and ownership mindset: you can ship and operate reliable services
Proficiency in Go or readiness to switch; Python is also welcome (other languages can be useful for OSS debugging/fixes)
You don’t have to be Network expert but we expect you to have interest in infrastructure and/or network

Meet DeepL
DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.
Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.
What sets us apart
What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.
When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.
What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL on LinkedIn , Instagram , and our Blog .

s.h: MMeet the team behind this journey
s.t:
DeepL is not just a translation tool; we are building the Operating System for Global Communication . We are the rare AI company that builds the entire stack in-house: from training next-gen LLMs on our own NVIDIA DGX SuperPODs to delivering real-time Language AI to over 300 million users and 200,000+ businesses globally.
You will join the API Enterprise team. We sit at the intersection of DeepL's API platform and our Enterprise ecosystem.

Whereas the Core team obsesses over the self-service developer journey, our focus is on enterprise customer adoption: the usage insights, cost controls, RBAC , compliance, and data residency capabilities that enterprise IT and security teams depend on.

We work hand-in-hand with a wide set of stakeholder teams to make DeepL's API the obvious and safe choice for global enterprises.
We are shifting gears. We are moving from "Software-First" to "Product-First." We don't hire engineers to just close tickets or optimize algorithms in isolation. We hire Missionaries—builders who obsess over the Why before the How.

At VREY , we're building the EnergyOS for multi-family buildings .
Germany has over 3.3 million apartment buildings — and they are the blind spot of the energy transition. <1% solar penetration. <2% smart metering. Almost no flexibility or intelligent energy management.
At the same time, regulation is forcing property owners into major investment: solar is becoming mandatory, smart meters must be rolled out nationwide within five years, heating and mobility are electrifying. The apartment building is transforming from passive real estate into an active part of the decentralised energy infrastructure.
What's missing is an integrated system that makes this transition economically viable and operationally manageable.
VREY combines certified meter operation with proprietary software , enabling property owners to sell self-generated solar power directly to their tenants — simply, and without having to become an energy supplier themselves (§42b EnWG). Regulatory obligation becomes a profitable, predictable opportunity:
Double-digit returns and asset appreciation for owners,
~20% electricity cost savings for tenants, and
digital infrastructure for storage, heat pumps, and flexibility.
We already manage a three-digit number of projects — including some of Germany's largest property holders and housing cooperatives — in all 16 federal states. CMBlu Energy befindet sich auf der spannenden Reise hin zu einem globalen Cleantech-Unternehmen. Unsere Mission: Unbegrenzte Energiespeicherung nach dem Vorbild der Natur ermöglichen – und das für alle, weltweit.
Was sind SolidFlow -Batterien?
SolidFlow -Batterien speichern Energie in organischen Molekülen. Der Verzicht auf explosive Materialien macht sie sicher, der Einsatz von sozial und ökologisch konfliktfreien Rohstoffen nachhaltig und die nahezu unbegrenzte Materialverfügbarkeit skalierbar und günstig in der Beschaffung. Das macht unsere patentierte SolidFlow - Technologie zu einem Gamechanger im Aufbau eines globalen klimaneutralen Energiesystems.
Vom Start-up zum Scale-up: Gemeinsam packen wir es an
CMBlu Energy entwickelt sich von einem Start-up mit Forschungsschwerpunkt zu einem produzierenden Scale-up, das sich auf dem Sprung in die Serienproduktion befindet. An diesem Ziel arbeiten rund 250 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bei CMBlu Energy. Unser Hauptsitz ist in Alzenau nähe Frankfurt , mit einer Zwei g stelle in Obernburg. Hinzu kommen Tochtergesellschaften in Athen, Griechenland und Petaluma, USA.
Deine Mission
Möchtest du Software, Datenpipelines und KI bauen, die Batterieforschung schneller machen? Bei uns entwickelst du die Systeme, die aus unseren Forschungs-, Pilot- und Produktionsdaten bessere Materialien und Zellen machen – und die KI-Werkzeuge, mit denen unsere Chemie- und Elektrochemie-Teams jeden Tag arbeiten.
Du bist stark in der Software-Entwicklung, hast ein Faible für Daten und echten Bock auf KI in ihrer ganzen Breite – von LLMs und Agenten bis zu klassischem Machine Learning. Sauberes Engineering verbindest du mit Databricks, Azure und Claude zu Werkzeugen, die es so nicht von der Stange gibt.
Damit gibst du unserer Forschung nicht nur Daten, sondern Antworten – und den Hebel, schneller die richtigen Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Deine Aufgaben
Produktionsreife Software entwickeln – APIs, Services und interne Web-Apps in modernem Python (uv, FastAPI/uvicorn), mit sauberer Architektur, Tests und CI/CD; etwa Analyse-Apps, mit denen Forschende ihre Testdaten auswerten, als Databricks Apps über Asset Bundles und GitLab deployt.
KI-Anwendungen für die Forschung entwickeln – Assistenten und Agenten, die R&D bei Aufgaben wie Recherche, Hypothesenbildung, Materialauswahl und Syntheseplanung unterstützen. Du kombinierst LLMs und Agenten (u. a. Claude über MCP) mit wissenschaftlichen Methoden wie Cheminformatik, Retrosynthese und Quantenchemie – und treibst diese Werkzeuge kontinuierlich voran.
KI breit denken – nicht nur LLMs – klassisches Machine Learning dort einsetzen, wo es das bessere Werkzeug ist: Zusammenhänge zwischen Material und Performance modellieren, Datenqualität und Anomalien erkennen, Lebensdauer und Degradation vorhersagen.
Skalierbare Daten-Pipelines und unsere Datenplattform bauen und betreiben – nach dem Bronze/Silver/Gold-Prinzip auf Databricks und Azure, von der Sensor-Ingestion (MQTT, Event Hubs, Lakeflow) bis zu den Gold-Tabellen, mit denen die Fachbereiche direkt arbeiten.
Deine Systeme end-to-end verantworten – von der Datenquelle über Modell bzw. Agent bis zum Werkzeug in der Hand der Forschenden, inklusive Security, Observability, Qualität und Verlässlichkeit.
Eng mit Chemie, Elektrochemie, Engineering und Testing zusammenarbeiten und wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen in Software- und KI-Lösungen übersetzen.
Dein Profil
Du bist in erster Linie starke:r Entwickler:in – mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bau produktionsreifer Software, mit Gespür für Architektur, sauberem Code, Testing und CI/CD (idealerweise GitLab).
Du beherrschst Python sehr sicher (und SQL) und bist beim Entwurf von APIs, Services und Microservices zu Hause.
Du hast solide Data-Engineering-Erfahrung – Databricks und PySpark, die Medaillon-Architektur (Bronze/Silver/Gold), Batch- und Streaming-Pipelines sowie der Azure-Data-Stack (Data Factory, ADLS Gen2, Event Hubs).
Du hast echte Affinität zu KI in der ganzen Breite – praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs und generativer KI (RAG, Agenten, MCP, Tools wie Claude) und ein fundiertes Verständnis von klassischem Machine Learning – und du weißt, wann du was einsetzt.
Du willst an der Schnittstelle aus Software, Daten, KI und Naturwissenschaften arbeiten und bringst die Neugier mit, dich in unsere Domäne – Batterie, Chemie, Elektrochemie – einzudenken.
Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch von Vorteil.

About CoLab At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner. CoLab is the AI platform for driving stronger engineering decisions.

Every design review in CoLab builds a knowledge repository of design feedback, decisions, and lessons learned - which AI agents draw from to flag issues on future designs before they compound. The more your team works in CoLab, the smarter it gets and the faster you arrive at the ideal design.

Companies like Ford, Komatsu, and Johnson Controls use CoLab to catch issues earlier, eliminate rework cycles, and bring products to market faster. Founded in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab has grown quickly from our first customer in 2019 to a rapidly scaling company.

We've recently been recognized on Deloitte's Fast 50™ and Fast 500™, and named a Canadian company to watch by The Globe and Mail and Financial Post. About the Role Modern engineering teams invest a significant amount of time and money on simulation.

Before anything gets built, teams need confidence that a design is going to work: structurally, thermally, aerodynamically, etc. Simulation is one of the main ways they build that confidence. But the way teams share and review simulation results to make decisions is still pretty broken.

Engineers are exporting videos, taking screenshots, dropping them into PowerPoint, and then trying to make decisions through email threads, meetings, or disconnected slide decks.

The actual decision-making ends up separated from the underlying simulation data, which means context gets lost, feedback is hard to trace, and important engineering knowledge disappears into the workflow. CoLab already helps engineering teams review CAD, capture feedback, and make better design decisions in one connected workspace.

Now we’re extending that same idea into simulation. The goal is simple: make simulation results collaborative, reviewable, and traceable in the same way CoLab does for CAD today. We’re starting a new product team focused on bringing simulation review into CoLab.

As one of the first engineers on that team, you’ll help define how simulation data gets ingested, visualized, discussed, and connected back to real engineering decisions.

There are a lot of interesting technical problems here: large datasets, high-performance visualization, viewer interactions, data pipelines, and user experiences that need to work for mechanical engineers doing critical product development work.

The first phase is about learning the product, the customers, and the review workflows we already support today. You’ll spend time embedded with our Engineering Reviews team, learning how engineers collaborate in CoLab, where the current product is strong, and where simulation creates a new set of problems we need to solve.

From there, you’ll help build the foundation for a new Simulation team - not just technically, but from a product perspective as well. We want to build something customers actually need and will use in their day-to-day work, and that requires a highly product oriented approach.

Our Ideal Candidate You're the kind of developer who wants to understand why a feature matters before deciding how to build it. You enjoy owning complex technical problems, but you also enjoy talking with product managers, designers, and customers to understand what success actually looks like.

You make thoughtful technical decisions independently and know when to bring others into the conversation. Experience working with simulation software is a significant advantage. Maybe you've worked with FEA, CFD, multiphysics simulations, scientific visualization, or engineering data platforms.

You understand the kinds of problems engineers are trying to solve. This is a good fit for someone who likes ambiguity, wants to work closely with our product and leadership teams, and cares about the connection between technical decisions and customer value.

You’ll have a meaningful role in shaping both the architecture and the user experience for a new capability that we think can become a major part of engineering review in CoLab. What You'll Do
Help design and build CoLab's next-generation simulation review capabilities.
Build services that ingest and process simulation data from industry-standard engineering software.
Develop high-performance visualization experiences capable of displaying large simulation datasets.
Partner closely with Product, Design, and customers to validate ideas before building them.
Spend time embedded with the Engineering Reviews team to develop deep product and customer understanding before transitioning onto the Simulation team.
Contribute to architectural decisions that will shape this product area for years to come.
Improve performance, scalability, and reliability as simulation capabilities grow.
Collaborate with engineers across the platform to ensure simulation becomes a seamless part of the broader CoLab experience.

About Abnormal AI Abnormal AI is the leading AI-native security platform, protecting enterprise organizations from the full spectrum of cyber attacks.

Powered by behavioral AI that understands human and machine identity, Abnormal detects and prevents attacks that evade traditional security tools — from sophisticated email threats to identity compromise and SaaS application abuse.

Trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises — including over 25% of the Fortune 500 — Abnormal processes billions of identity signals daily to protect people, data at scale. Why this role exists To address rapidly escalating customer demand, the BIS organization is growing its team dedicated to Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM).

ISPM provides ongoing tracking of an enterprise's identity setups—including Okta, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Entra—revealing hidden vulnerabilities that build up across these networks.

It packages these insights into an intuitive, actionable format, empowering security teams to understand their current defense status and prioritize critical remediation efforts.

With identity now serving as the main attack vector for modern enterprises, having complete visibility to understand every identity in your environment and proactively eliminate risk before it's exploited is more essential than ever.

AI Enablement is the team that builds the AI infrastructure the rest of Clara's engineering org runs on. We're not a team that "adds AI to a product" — we build the tools other teams build with.

Live examples today: Clara Builders (an internal skills marketplace and self-service app platform), an agent that turns Figma designs directly into production code through MCP, a documentation agent that keeps internal knowledge in sync with the codebases it describes, and n8n automations already running in production across several business teams.
We're looking for a senior engineer to own the frontend architecture of Clara Builders and go deep on the systems behind it — backend services, agent infrastructure, and the AI tooling other teams across Clara rely on. This is deliberately not a frontend-only role: you'll be expected to move into backend and infra whenever the problem calls for it, and to build AI tooling yourself rather than just apply it to your own tickets.
Concretely, Clara Builders is a Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript app on Prisma/Postgres, with a self-service Dokploy deploy pipeline (staging → beta → production, gated by a pending/approved environment lifecycle) and a Cloudflare AI Gateway layer that proxies multiple LLM providers behind one internal endpoint.

You'd be joining while we're actively building the next layer on top of that: OAuth Clients support and unified access proposals, both in progress and largely undocumented today — you'd be shaping them, not inheriting a finished spec.
We move fast and trust our engineers to own outcomes end-to-end. That means autonomy to make decisions, proactivity to surface problems before they become blockers, and the attitude to push initiatives across the finish line without waiting to be told what to do.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Are you a recent or upcoming graduate ready to launch your career at the forefront of industrial IoT? Join us and help shape the future of connected operations. You will immediately dive into challenging, real-world projects with the freedom and responsibility of a full-time engineer.

We believe in providing a greenfield opportunity for growth and a high degree of ownership from day one. You will build and innovate, making a tangible impact on our global customers. You'll also have access to the latest AI tools, with generous token allotments, giving you the leverage to ship more and learn faster.
At Samsara, New Grads can work on a wide range of high-impact engineering challenges across our connected operations platform.

Depending on the team, a New Grad may help build the backend infrastructure that powers our IoT platform, scaling data ingestion and storage systems that support over 15,000 hardware assets and tens of thousands of customers around the world.

They may also work across the full stack, creating intuitive user experiences that turn data from millions of devices into actionable insights, while partnering closely with product and design to rapidly iterate on features that deliver real customer value.
On the mobile side, a New Grad could help strengthen the infrastructure behind our React Native app, enabling feature teams to move quickly and build performant, maintainable products. For those focused on embedded software, projects may include building and maintaining software that runs directly on Samsara hardware, spanning areas like edge AI, multimedia frameworks, power management, and real-time data processing in demanding real-world environments.
Throughout the interview process, we will dig into your past experience, what you are most interested in learning next, and where you would be the best fit across our engineering teams.
Our engineering teams use Golang for backend development, TypeScript and React for the web client, GraphQL for data access, and React Native for mobile development. Direct experience with this exact stack is not required, but experience with similar technologies is strongly encouraged.
